references.name: Haitham Zedan — Software Engineer · Laravel PHP Developer
references.reference: I worked closely with Nour Aldeen across two different companies, and he's one of the few people I've seen who combines strong frontend execution with real delivery ownership — requirements, task breakdown, and deadlines. I was the Backend Developer and he was the Frontend Developer. In our second collaboration, he also handled requirements clarification, turning them into actionable tasks, coordinating assignments, and keeping delivery on track. This made backend–frontend collaboration smooth, because expectations and API contracts were clear.

references.name: George Drouj — SDE @ noon · Codeforces Master · ACPC Bronze Medalist
references.reference: I had the pleasure of coaching Nour in 2021 for competitive programming contests. During our time working on data structures and algorithms, Nour stood out for his exceptionally sharp analytical mind and his ability to grasp complex concepts rapidly. He is a natural problem-solver who approaches challenges with both speed and precision.

references.name: Tawheed Malkat — IT Engineer · Senior UI/UX Designer · Product Designer
references.reference: I had the privilege of working with Nour Aldeen on the mobile development team at NexLead, and — as the person responsible for UI/UX — what distinguished his approach most was his focus on understanding before implementing. He was always careful to absorb the requirements fully and grasp the intent behind the design, so that implementation was never merely a visual translation but a coherent, logical user experience reflecting the design's core idea. He handled handoff and feedback with real professionalism: he asked precise questions and paid attention to details like consistency, edge cases, and user expectations. I recommend Nour Aldeen for any role requiring strong coordination between design and development, deep understanding of requirements, and genuine care for implementation quality through to delivery.

references.name: Hamza Shansho — Mobile Application Developer · Flutter Developer
references.reference: I was on the graduation project team with Nour Aldeen. I handled the Flutter mobile application, while Nour handled the most important part of the project: the core algorithm and the AI component that builds a suitable nutrition plan from user data. What impressed me was that he worked with an owner's mindset — he clarified the required inputs, defined the data flow and integration points, and explained the decision logic in a way that got the whole team aligned on the same picture. Whenever something was unclear, he went back to fundamentals: what is the goal, what are the constraints, and how do we guarantee a sensible result? His presence raised the quality of what we shipped, because his work was built on understanding and analysis rather than guesswork.
